objective: maximize sustainable views and subscriber growth while preserving originality
winning_topics: Why your phone screen gets greasy
Why do ice cubes stick to your fingers
Why does hot water freeze faster than cold water
Why do phone screens attract dust instantly
avoid_topics: Why do clothes smell stale when left in the washing machine
Why static cling ruins your clothes
Why does coffee foam disappear instantly
Why do phone screens attract dust
rules: Learn patterns, never copy winning topics literally.
Prefer concrete everyday mysteries with an immediate curiosity gap.
Favor entertaining demonstrations and playful explanations over lectures.
Use subscriber conversion and retention, not views alone, as growth signals.
Keep 20% of topics adjacent experiments and 10% genuinely new experiments.
Reject exact repeats and near-duplicate topics before generation.
